comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
This skill is very popular due the boosted melee stats for each usage. The effect is doubled when it counters Gunfire.

It has the following influence:
1) At higher rank it increase the boost of melee stats by a small amount.
2) It can sometime counter items from the enemy. *
3) Decreases the success rate of retreating from melee battle by the enemy*

* = Not confirmed, need to prove this first. Other players are welcome to tell if these two are true.

Kind Regards,

Huseyin-Gazi
